rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose pattern for an object or part located on the outside.

example.english: The wall on the outward side is a bit dirty.
example.jyutping: ngoi6 min6 ge3 coeng4 san1 jau5 di1 wu1 zou1

rows.note: Use this when the object is oriented or facing toward the outside rather than merely being on the outer side.

example.english: The outward-facing window needs to be closed again.
example.jyutping: hoeng3 ngoi6 ge3 coeng1 jiu3 saan1 faan1
